Home -> Character Info -> Equipment

Equipment


For Equipment Stats, please visit: http://daranmadrox.zxq.net/games/iom/eqstats/


 

Decay Scale

  • It is in mint condition and is brand new.
  • It is in near-mint condition and is as good as new.
  • It is in excellent condition and has seen some use.
  • It is in great condition and has been well repaired.
  • It is in good shape and has been patched a few times.
  • It is somewhat scratched and has been heavily used.
  • It is heavily scratched and is heavily decayed.
  • It is in a battered condition and is nearly worn out.
  • It is broken and unusable.

 

Types Of EQ

  • Regular
    Any basic item currently available in-game
  • Nosave
    Any item that will not save on a player's body, in a castle, or on the ground
  • Magical
    Any item that gives some sort of bonus and is currently available in-game
  • Unique
    Special items with only one copy distributed in-game through various methods
  • Ungettable
    Special items that have been changed and the original was not removed -or- special items that have been removed
  • Random pool
    Magical items randomly dropped by random smaller EQ monsters
  • Random unique
    Special magical items dropped by random exp monsters that last about a couple of weeks before disappearing. Items are only useable by the player or players in the party that killed the monster that dropped it. Many items are unique items that are no longer in-game
  • Random newbie
    Magical items dropped by random monsters that are only useable by the newbie player or players in the party that killed the monster that dropped it
  • Spider silks
    Silks are dropped by spiders and driders from the Lloth's Children event and can be made into special magical items. Silks can also be combined to save inventory space
  • Spider silk EQ
    Spider silk items do not give normal stat bonuses. Instead they give specials with varying power, depending on how much silks are used in the item creation. The specials include: randomly drain the wearer's enemies of sp, randomly damage the wearer's enemies, or randomly reduces the wearer's spell casting time
    Combined Silk Ball Sizes
    • miniscule
    • tiny
    • small
    • smaller than average
    • average
    • larger than average
    • large
    • huge
    • gigantic

  • Guild Created
    Nosave magical items, created by different guilds, with most items having stats tailored to the guild that created it. Some items are needed to perform guild functions. Special types of guild created items include Lava and Shadow which are described a little more below
  • Lava
    Nosave magical items, created by Lava Mage guild members, with random stat bonuses generated on item creation
  • Shadow
    Nosave magical items created by Disciple Of Shadow guild members
  • Formulas
    Formulas are dropped by random monsters and can only be used by Master Enchanter guild members by teaching them one paticular slot and enchantment type that they can cast
  • SNAFU
    Magical items created from a collection of various animal body parts looted from the SNAFU Forest and are only useable by newbies
    Stat-Animal Key:
    • STR: Termite
    • DEX: Weasel
    • CON: Moose
    • STA: Stallion
    • INT: Hedgehog
    • WIS: Turtle
    • CHA: Kagaroo
    • HPR: Rabbit
    • SPR: Dragon
    • EPR: Wombat

  • Spellbooks/Rings of knowledge
    Magical items that let the wearer cast a paticular spell at about a 75% studied level. You must look at the book/ring to determine what spell it allows the wearer to cast
    Gettable books include:
    • Barkskin
    • Clairvoyance
    • Condition Orbit
    • Create Food
    • Create Navigation Stone
    • Diagnose
    • Distant Sell
    • Enlarge Weapon
    • Estimate Worth
    • Heavy Weight
    • Identify
    • Know Alignment
    • Magical Void
    • Remove Poison
    • Remove Scar
    • Shrink Weapon

    Ungettable books include:
    • Carrier Pigeon
    • Continual Darkness
    • Continual Light
    • Cure Light Wounds
    • Heal All In Mud
    • Prayer For Mankind

    Gettable rings include:
    • Air Shield
    • Darkness
    • Flame Blade
    • Guild Portal
    • Identify
    • Light

  • Tickets
    Tickets are general items that can be used for certain special abilities or for certain special effects and are given out for various reasons
    Gettable tickets include:
    • Free Resurrect
    • Free Reinc
    • Free Exp
    • Equipment Repair
    • Random Event
    • Battle Royale Event
    • Berserking Lessons Event
    • Dhrugs' Rage Event
    • Escape From Hell Event
    • Feast Of Fools Event
    • Lloth's Children Event
    • Nosuck Event
    • Time Of Life Event
    • Personal Nosuck
    • Personal Time Of Life
    • Time Of Life Event

  • Lodestones
    Navigaton stones that transport you to either a random preset location or a location that can be chosen by the owner and are created via the spell Create Navigation Stone. You must look at the lodestone to determine what location it allows the user to transport to
  • Race Leadership
    Magical items given to the current race leader

The specials include: randomly drain the wearer's enemies of sp, randomly damage the wearer's enemies, or randomly reduces the wearer's spell casting time
Combined Silk Ball Sizes
miniscule
tiny
small
smaller than average
average
larger than average
large
huge
gigantic
Guild Created
Nosave magical items, created by different guilds, with most items having stats tailored to the guild that created it. Some items are needed to perform guild functions. Special types of guild created items include Lava and Shadow which are described a little more below
Lava
Nosave magical items, created by Lava Mage guild members, with random stat bonuses generated on item creation
Shadow
Nosave magical items created by Disciple Of Shadow guild members
Formulas
Formulas are dropped by random monsters and can only be used by Master Enchanter guild members by teaching them one paticular slot and enchantment type that they can cast
SNAFU
Magical items created from a collection of various animal body parts looted from the SNAFU Forest and are only useable by newbies
Stat-Animal Key:
STR: Termite
DEX: Weasel
CON: Moose
STA: Stallion
INT: Hedgehog
WIS: Turtle
CHA: Kagaroo
HPR: Rabbit
SPR: Dragon
EPR: Wombat
Spellbooks/Rings of knowledge
Magical items that let the wearer cast a paticular spell at about a 75% studied level. You must look at the book/ring to determine what spell it allows the wearer to cast
Gettable books include:
Barkskin
Clairvoyance
Condition Orbit
Create Food
Create Navigation Stone
Diagnose
Distant Sell
Enlarge Weapon
Estimate Worth
Heavy Weight
Identify
Know Alignment
Magical Void
Remove Poison
Remove Scar
Shrink Weapon
Ungettable books include:
Carrier Pigeon
Continual Darkness
Continual Light
Cure Light Wounds
Heal All In Mud
Prayer For Mankind
Gettable rings include:
Air Shield
Darkness
Flame Blade
Guild Portal
Identify
Light
Tickets
Tickets are general items that can be used for certain special abilities or for certain special effects and are given out for various reasons
Gettable tickets include:
Free Resurrect
Free Reinc
Free Exp
Equipment Repair
Random Event
Battle Royale Event
Berserking Lessons Event
Dhrugs' Rage Event
Escape From Hell Event
Feast Of Fools Event
Lloth's Children Event
Nosuck Event
Time Of Life Event
Personal Nosuck
Personal Time Of Life
Time Of Life Event
Lodestones
Navigaton stones that transport you to either a random preset location or a location that can be chosen by the owner and are created via the spell Create Navigation Stone. You must look at the lodestone to determine what location it allows the user to transport to
Race Leadership
Magical items given to the current race leader

Races


MCCP Specials

  • Cromagnon: (automatic) - Stuns your enemy and deals physical damage to your enemy
  • Drow: (automatic) - Insta-casts a spell that you are casting
  • Dwarf: (automatic) - Finds gold and gems in rooms
  • Elf: (automatic) - Insta-casts a spell that you are casting
  • Ent: (automatic) - Replenishes your hunger while in sunlight
  • Faerie: (automatic) - Gives a minor hp heal to all your party companions in the room
  • Gargoyle: (automatic) - Stuns your evil-aligned enemy
  • Giant: (manual, syntax: 'shout Fee, fie, fo, fum!') - Breaks a stun that you are affected by
  • Gnome: (automatic) - Casts a minor protection spell on you; either Mind Sponge or Armor Of Faith
  • Goblin: (automatic) - Deals physical damage to your enemy
  • Grorrark: (manual, syntax: 'roar' or 'roar LIV') - Stuns your enemy and can force your enemy to flee the room
  • Halfelf: (automatic) - Insta-casts a spell that you are casting -or- gives you a 200% exp bonus
  • Hobbit: (automatic) - Gives you +25dex as long as your hunger is over 90%
  • Human: (automatic) - Gives you a 200% exp bonus
  • Kobold: (automatic) - Allows you to flee the room with no penalties
  • Leprechaun: (automatic) - Dodges damage dealt to you
  • Lizardman: (automatic) - Gives extra hp regen after going near water
  • Mindflayer: (automatic) - Deals psionic damage to your enemy
  • Minotaur: (automatic) - Deals physical damage to your enemy
  • Ogier: (automatic) - Repairs stone and metal equipment in your inventory
  • Phoenix: (automatic) - Deals fire damage to your enemy
  • Snakeman: (automatic) - Gives you full regen at sunbreak if you are in the sunlight
  • Thrikhren: (automatic) - Gives you +con after eating a corpse
  • Troll: (automatic) - Gives you extra hp regen, sp regen, and ep regen bonuses
  • Vampire: (automatic) - Deals physical damage to your enemy and causes a 1-round bleeding wound
  • Vinnipier: (automatic) - Gives you a few gold from all the players in the room
  • Xorn: (manual, syntax: 'dig to adv-guild') - Relocates you back to the Adventurer's Guild

  • Celestial Mage:

    • Archdemon: (automatic) - Stuns enemies -or- sp drains enemies
  • Ghyrdon: (automatic) - Causes combat to stop with animal type enemies

Stats


Effects

Strength: .5hp/+1str, melee hit power, size of weapons that are wieldable, inventory size
Dexterity: .5ep/1dex, most defensive abilities, amount of melee hits
Constitution: 2.5hp/1con
Stamina: +2.5ep/1sta
Intelligence: +2sp/1int, most attack spells' damage
Widsom: +2sp/1wis, most healing spell power
Charisma: influences how much you can buy/sell items in shops
HP Max: +5hp/1hpmax
SP Max: +5sp/1spmax
EP Max: +5ep/1hpmax


 

Messages

Strength

  • Increase: You feel stronger
  • Decrease: You feel weaker

Dexterity

  • Increase: You feel agile.
  • Decrease: You feel slower.

Constitution

  • Increase: Your muscles swell.
  • Decrease: Your muscles shrink.

Stamina

  • Increase: You feel more endurant.
  • Decrease: You feel a bit drained.

Intelligence

  • Increase: Your brain feels like a sponge.
  • Decrease: You are a little confused.

Widsom

  • Increase: You feel witty.
  • Decrease: You feel less witty.

Charisma

  • Increase: You feel more charismatic.
  • Decrease: You seem less of a leader.

Hit Point Regen

  • Increase: Your heart beats an extra beat.
  • Decrease: Your heart skips a beat.

Spell Point Regen

  • Increase: Your brain pulses.
  • Decrease: Your brain slows down.

Endurance Point Regen

  • Increase: You feel refreshed.
  • Decrease: You feel tired.

All Spells

  • Increase: Your spell knowledge increases.
  • Decrease: Your spell knowledge decreases.

All Skills

  • Increase: Your skill knowledge increases.
  • Decrease: Your skill knowledge decreases.

Acid Resistance

  • Increase: Your skin becomes resistant.
  • Decrease: Your skin becomes less resistant.

Asphyxiation Resistance

  • Increase: Your throat clears.
  • Decrease: Your throat clogs back up.

Cold Resistance

  • Increase: You feel warm.
  • Decrease: You feel less resistant to cold.

Electric Resistance

  • Increase: You feel less conductive.
  • Decrease: You feel more conductive.

Fire Resistance

  • Increase: You feel cool.
  • Decrease: You feel less resistant to fire.

Holy Resistance

  • Increase: You feel closer to the good gods.
  • Decrease: You feel further from the good gods.

Magical Resistance

  • Increase: You feel arcane power.
  • Decrease: You feel a loss of arcane power.

Physical Resistance

  • Increase: You feel resistant.
  • Decrease: You feel less resistant.

Poison Resistance

  • Increase: You feel your internals strengthen.
  • Decrease: You feel your internals weaken.

Psionic Resistance

  • Increase: You feel your brain structure align.
  • Decrease: You feel your brain lose focus.

Unholy Resistance

  • Increase: You feel closer to the evil gods.
  • Decrease: You feel further from the evil gods.

Height

  • Increase: Your body grows.
  • Decrease: Your body shrinks.

Weight

  • Increase: You feel heavier than air.
  • Decrease: You feel lighter than air.

  • WIS: Athena

Home -> Character Info -> Reinc Tax

Reinc Tax


Reinc Tax Reduction
Tax naturally goes down on an in-game daily basis. It is not based on logged-in time.
Certain equipment and gold can be sacrificed (given) to Eje in Illium's Church to reduce your reincarnation tax as well.
For Eje to accept an item, it usually must have either +8 to atleast one basic stat, +3 to atleast one resistance, +5% to atleast one alpha type spell/skill, or +3% to atleast one bravo type spell/skill.


Gold Sacrifice Tax Reduction Formula
A=B*2^(-G/1000000)

A: Tax after saccing item
B: Tax before saccing item
G: Gold amount


Effects

  • 50,000 gold: Natural daily reduction
  • 1,000,000 gold (tax>.5%): Reduces your tax by half
  • 1,000,000 gold (tax<.5%): Reduces your tax by about .1%
  • Item worth 0tps: 100,000 gold
  • Item worth 1tp: 250,000 gold
  • Item worth 2tps: 500,000 gold
  • Item worth 3tps: 800,000 gold
  • Item worth 5tps: 1,600,000 gold
  • Item worth 7tps: 3,000,000 gold
  • Item worth 10tps: 4,000,000 gold
